paragraphs.text: Puts your own image and text inside the window title bar of the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell — the
40px row that holds the sidebar toggle, the native 应用 / 编辑 menus and the minimize / maximize / clos
e buttons. A Title bar page in Settings edits the content.
# dsh-app-row-brand
English | 中文

Puts your own image and text inside the **window title bar** of the DeepSeek
Harness desktop shell —

the 40px row that holds the sidebar toggle, the native
应用 / 编辑 menus and the minimize / maximize /

close buttons. A **Title bar**
page in Settings edits the content.
## What it does

- Registers one entry into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot and pins a strip
to the viewport top,

inside the title-bar area that the shell paints for
`[data-windows-titlebar]`. Nothing inside a col

umn is replaced, so the
sidebar's own brand row stays as shipped.
- Holds a list of up to 12 items.

With more than one item the strip rotates:
every item has its own display time in seconds (stored as

`durationMs`).
- Each item carries text, text color, font family, font size, bold, underline,
image

, image width, alignment, and an optional shimmer.
- Fonts are read from the machine: the Local Font

Access API when the shell
grants it, otherwise canvas metric probing over a candidate list, so the

Settings picker lists the families that are actually installed.
- Shimmer is the status-widget techn

ique: the glyphs are filled with a
horizontally repeating gradient whose highlight tile advances one

tile per
cycle, clipped to the text. Cycle time (seconds), highlight color and sweep
direction (lef

t to right by default, or right to left) are per item.
- The displayed item can be stepped manually

and pinned: a pinned item stays on
screen and stops the rotation until it is unpinned.
- Any item ca

n be marked **temporarily hidden**: rotation, Previous and Next
skip it, and its entry in the picker

shows a “hidden” badge. Unhiding brings
it straight back into the rotation (and a pin on it becomes

active again).
- The image height is locked to the title-bar height (40px); only its width is
confi

gurable (8–240px).
- Uploaded images are scaled to the bar height and stored as a data URL in
`local

Storage`; an image link can be used instead.
- Outside the Windows desktop shell the strip renders n

othing, so a plain web
page is unaffected.
## Install
From npm:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From this checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

In DSH Desktop use the plugin manager instead of the command line, and restart
the app once so the r

enderer picks up a brand-new client module. Later edits to
a linked checkout hot-reload.
Open **Settings → 标题栏 / Title bar** to edit the items.
## Settings
| Field | Effect |

| Items | select an item, add or remove one |
| Order | move the selected item up or down; rotation

follows the new order |
| Visibility | temporarily hide the selected item; rotation, Previous and Ne

xt skip it |
| Display control | Previous / Pin (toggle) / Next, plus the current “showing N of M” s

tate |
| Text | item text, up to 60 characters |
| Color | swatch plus R/G/B inputs |
| Font / size

| installed fonts with a Custom… escape hatch; 9–40px |
| Bold / underline | font weight 700 and und

erline |
| Image / width | upload, link or clear; width 8–240px |
| Alignment | center / right / lef

t inside the bar |
| Shimmer | on/off, cycle in seconds, sweep direction, highlight color |
| Displa
y time | per-item dwell time in seconds before the next item |
## How it is wired
| File | Role |

| `cordis.patch.yml` | Profile layer: inserts the `dsh-app-row-brand` row |
| `index.js` | Host half

: empty `apply()` |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the overlay strip, the carousel and the Settings p

age |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-page title and description |

`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (makes the package a profile layer)
and `dsh.client` with

`inject`, naming the two slot owners the browser half
extends: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`

(frame + `shell.overlay`) and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`.
## Limits

- Values are stored per browser profile in `localStorage`, not in the profile's
plugin config.
- Upl

oaded images are re-encoded to PNG at 4× the bar height; very large
pictures may exceed the local st

orage budget and are rejected.
- The strip is a drag region and does not intercept pointer input.
-
Rotation only advances while the strip is mounted (desktop window present).
